notes: Replace source account with eventDeliveryAccount and listed owned prefixes with stable local names in inputs and independent native records.
Replay event-window instants remain the captured absolute instants; numeric IAM timestamps are rendered RFC3339 at captured CloudTrail second precision in SDK inputs.
Normalize each response creationTime/replayStartTime to the manual-clock instant of the explicitly named earlier SDK call; no expected request is derived from the local serializer.

Native request/event IDs remain provenance only. Local response IDs correlate the actual SDK call with LookupEvents. CLI wire artifacts did not expose request IDs; source matches use operation, independent request parameters, assumed-role identity for denials and request-time interval.
The IAM trust principal is changed from the captured Delegated IAM user to the local account root. Session policies and action/resource distinctions remain native.
Native opaque pagination tokens are replaced by the actual SDK token from token_from, in input and expected native request only.

Native scheduling latency is not an oracle: SDK calls share a frozen manual clock until advance_seconds explicitly advances and drains local deterministic replay jobs. Empty archives suffice for management projections; no event insertion or synthetic journal records are used.

exclusions: Client-only ParamValidation calls never reached AWS and have no native CloudTrail projection.
RetentionDays=2147483648 lies outside the generated int32 SDK model; its wire success is retained in the control source artifact, not replayed by this SDK fixture.

Uncaptured outcomes are not inferred: invalid event-pattern and generated member-validation rejections, ListArchives DISABLED-filter success, StartReplay bad-source-bus and later filtered/terminal-cancel requests lacked a matching record in this polling window.
Repeated Describe polling, duplicate cleanup absence, overlapping successful updates and selector reads with the same projection are represented once per meaningful document/state distinction.

KMS CreateKey/CreateAlias/DescribeKey/GenerateDataKey/Decrypt and encrypted-delivery setup are outside EventBridge management projection scope. Archive KMS nonempty and empty request members plus missing-key rejections are represented here; successful CMK alias/key variants and crypto behavior remain in the dedicated encryption evidence.

SQS rules/targets, public PutEvents, receipts, replay-delivery polling and irrelevant STS identity/setup records are not needed for management projections and are excluded. A single captured destination rule supplies successful nonempty FilterArns.
The failed primary sacrificial archive create does not prove an archive/bus relationship; the managed-source-removal scenario instead uses the successfully created target-control archive.
